excluded_pins.reason: Git clone, not an archive. 2.5.0 moved from SoftFever/Orca-deps-wxWidgets tag v3.3.2 to OrcaSlicer/Orca-deps-wxWidgets at commit b44c39c100975a0ac0e46f937aa3f3eae5e18631 (GIT_SHALLOW ON) with submodules 3rdparty/catch, 3rdparty/pcre and 3rdparty/libwebp. Review: issue #55 slice D2.

Git clone of tag v0.24.5 (GIT_SHALLOW ON, GIT_SUBMODULES_RECURSE ON: plog, usrsctp, libjuice); no commit or archive hash declared. Flatpak builds use a pre-cloned SOURCE_DIR instead. Needs tag-to-commit resolution and per-submodule revisions. Review: issue #55 slice B2.

MSVC only: prebuilt shared FFmpeg zips (winarm64, win64) from release autobuild-2026-09-18-16-50 of Noisyfox/FFmpeg-Builds-Orca; DLLs are copied into the prefix. Binary, not source. Review: issue #55 slice C1.

MSVC only: python/cpython-bin-deps archives libffi-3.4.4 (commit 94cb9a1c) and openssl-bin-3.0.16.2 (commit 1174fd43) contain prebuilt libraries linked into the bundled CPython. Binary inputs. Review: issue #55 slice C3.

Windows only, build-time only: nuget.org pythonarm64/pythonx86 3.13.16 packages that run CPython's PCbuild scripts, skipped when DEP_PYTHON_HOST is set. Binary tool, not shipped according to the build file. Review: issue #55 slice C3.

Prebuilt astral-sh/uv 0.11.21 release archives for six target triples, downloaded at configure time and installed into the application. Binary that ships. The Flatpak manifest pins the same version separately (not scanned). Review: issue #55 slice C2.

FetchContent of libigl v2.3.0 inside if(MCUT_BUILD_TESTS OR MCUT_BUILD_TUTORIALS). Those options default ON only when MCUT is the top-level project; OrcaSlicer adds it with add_subdirectory (deps_src/CMakeLists.txt:27), so this does not run in the OrcaSlicer build. Recorded so the coverage check accounts for it. Present in v2.4.2 too.
